headline: Director Vasquez-Obi Found Dead — Runner Signature All Over It
body:
Helix Biosystems Chief Operations Director Renata Vasquez-Obi, 58, was found dead in her private residence at the Orison Tower in The Spires at approximately 0610 hours this morning, dead from what sources close to the investigation describe as a precision neural-disruption event delivered through her NovaMind BCI implant. No physical point of entry was detected. No alarms were triggered. Vasquez-Obi's security detail found her seated upright at her desk, a half-finished glass of synthetic bourbon on the table beside her. The coroner's preliminary report, which this outlet has obtained, lists cause of death as 'catastrophic synaptic cascade — origin undetermined,' which is the polite way of saying someone cooked her brain from the inside.

Vasquez-Obi was one of the most powerful executives in Helix Biosystems' upper tier and the architect of the company's controversial SNT Licensing Partition initiative — a proposal that would have locked proprietary Synthetic Neural Thread access behind Helix's own hardware ecosystem, effectively cutting out Axiom and Sterling-Nakamura from the SNT supply chain. The initiative was two weeks from a board ratification vote. It is now dead alongside her.

Investigators from both Helix's internal security division and Meridian's Corporate Crime Unit are calling it a professional contract kill, citing the methodology's resemblance to at least two prior high-profile BCI assassinations attributed to a runner known in underworld circles as VELLUM. 'The signature is the silence,' a CCU investigator told this outlet anonymously. 'VELLUM doesn't leave debris. VELLUM leaves questions.' VELLUM's identity remains unknown — the handle has circulated in Graycloak channels for nearly six years with zero confirmed attribution.

The Iron Lotus syndicate has already issued a public non-denial denial through its usual intermediaries, which in their parlance is essentially a confirmation of non-involvement — meaning someone outside the established syndicate order commissioned this hit. Speculation is running hot that a rival corponation hired independent talent, but no one is saying the quiet part loud.
aftermath: Helix Biosystems' SNT Licensing Partition vote was indefinitely postponed, and the company's stock dropped 18 percent over the following two weeks before Axiom quietly acquired a controlling stake at the depressed price.
runner_relevance: Vasquez-Obi's death ignited a frantic secondary market for runners almost immediately. Helix Biosystems offered open bounty contracts — reportedly 80,000 quanta — for any verified intelligence on VELLUM's identity, drawing every information runner and Graycloak affiliate in Meridian into a competitive hunt. Simultaneously, the board members who supported the SNT Partition initiative began hiring round-the-clock protection runners, terrified they were next. Counter-runners were hired by unknown parties to disrupt those protection details. Data retrieval contracts emerged around recovering Vasquez-Obi's encrypted communications before Helix's own forensic teams could purge them, and at least one extraction contract was floated to pull a Helix whistleblower out of the Spires before corporate security could silence them.
